questions: Is Brent Key still the coach?

entries.answer: George Godsey is Georgia Tech's offensive coordinator and primary play-caller in 2026. He's a former GT quarterback with NFL play-calling experience. Chris Weinke is assistant head coach / co-OC / quarterbacks. Buster Faulkner left for Florida before this hire.
